newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo shrs up on institutional buying.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo shrs up on institutional buying.

text.p: All listed shares in South Korea's Daewoo Group jumped in active early Monday trading on bargain hunting by domestic institutional investors, brokers said.
The Daewoo Group has aggressively expanded its business abroad, especially in its automobile and electronics divisions, becoming South Korea's most active corporate group.
Brokers said institutional investors became liquid after they unloaded their shares following the expansion of South Korea's foreign stock ownership ceiling on October 1.
"They need to change their investment portfolio after the stock sales. Daewoo Group shares looked very cheap," Woo said.
Brokers said foreign investors wer ealso showing buying interest in Daewoo shares for similar reasons.
